name: Hours Check
office_task: When the pay week closes, check the crew's hours against the roster, their jobs and the dated award, put the odd ones in front of a named person, and send nothing to payroll until someone releases it.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds the allocations and roster (ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus or similar)
the payroll system that takes one export per period and returns its id (Xero Payroll, Employment Hero or MYOB)
the exception desk the business runs, for the anomaly queue

emits.write: the period report into the system the payroll officer opens: hours by person and day with totals that list the entry ids they sum, anomalies found and resolved, the award edition cited on each card, who released the period or that nobody has, and the payroll export id once one exists. Published every run, a clean period included
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the period id, the totals with their entry ids and the release field; the payroll export is read back by period with readExport, and a null external id is reported as a failed export, never a success

emits.write: an anomaly on the entry, from the closed list (over_hours, overlap, missing_break, not_rostered, not_allocated, rule_unclear), naming the person who owns it: the supervisor, whoever keeps the roster, the job's owner, or whoever answers for the award
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading the period's queue back returns that id with the entry id, the kind and the owner; one anomaly per entry and kind, so a retried wake raises none twice
